selectionPolicy.ordering: Roll concepts independently first; then contextual genre and remaining constraint-filtered decisions. Resolve nested interpretation branches without changing original concept IDs.
selectionPolicy.seed: Persist seed plus catalog/collection/compiler versions; adaptive collection changes require new snapshot version.
selectionPolicy.cardinality: Selections are unique option IDs; required min must be satisfiable, max is clipped only by an explicitly recorded policy, never silent duplication.
selectionPolicy.composition: Merge typed fragments using declared per-point rule; same scalar with unequal values is a conflict, not last-write-wins.
selectionPolicy.pruning: Resolve capability and cross-option predicates before model inference. Unsupported branch is rejected with reason; all branches exhausted fails idea.
selectionPolicy.noveltySampling: Prefer eligible undercovered combinations measured across view, topology, actions, consequences and visual identity; still enforce independent concept roll.
selectionPolicy.recursiveExpansion: Expand named child choice nodes lazily, memoize path; reject reference cycles. Stop at implemented capability leaves or explicit gaps. Complexity selects bounded branch/depth settings in execution packet, not total repair passes.
selectionPolicy.fragmentTarget: Fragments address an intermediate decisionsByPoint map. After merging, compiler emits the ordered decisions array in game profile; option ID keys retain each option parameters and provenance.
selectionPolicy.variationScopes: Record between-game, between-run and within-run variation separately; each claimed scope needs decision/outcome evidence.
selectionPolicy.layerContribution: Every selected gameplay layer needs a profile contribution and counterfactual assertion; presentation layers use visual/event evidence.
